description: Combat Extender compatibility test. P1 — stress-tests Stats mutation under MCM control.
assertions: assert(type(Ext.ModEvents['BG3SECompat']['Probe'].Subscribe) == 'function', 'ModEvents per-mod event object exposes Subscribe (MCM dep)')

assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'combatextender', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'Combat Extender present in load order')

assert((function() local entities=Ext.Entity.GetAllEntitiesWithComponent('eoc::character::CharacterComponent'); return type(entities) == 'table' and #entities > 0 end)(), 'loaded-save character entity query executes')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: Combat Extender requires MCM; the runner injects it automatically. Tests multi-mod loading + Stats mutation at runtime.
